hacker-infect-bottleneck-selected-area.head: 8547ef869a64b29656ff4c3153f7ccbeb2556226
hacker-infect-bottleneck-selected-area.scope: Stock empty and ally refusals, selected-area casts, exact recipient edges, movement-scale add and removal for Bottleneck, and eleven timed viral ticks for Infect. Infect magnitude and scaling remain open.

hacker-infect-area-one-selected-viral-do.head: 6267d5ba22bf0a9ae756ce2d7463ac3737f62c33
hacker-infect-area-one-selected-viral-do.scope: Stock PR905 at level 24 and legal 54/54 Hacker loadout. The actual cast paid 15 IS, lasted 2 s and started 12 s own reuse. The primary and exact 5.00 m edge alone received +114 stat 1157 for 30 s, then eleven 10-point ticks and removal. The ally and 5.01 m hostile received nothing. The archived 450-point generation remains unresolved.

353.note: The shipped fixed 94 is projected to +114 with +22% in the stock PR905 fixture. The earlier level-50 live record on MorpheuZZZ carried +450. Its original scaling inputs remain unresolved. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/905#issuecomment-7090233496

area.source: GOB 353 specifies a five-metre radius around the selected direct object and a 30-second ViralDOT.
area.runtime: AbilityHandler snapshots the selected hostile handle. AbilityTargets applies the target-centred recipient filter at landing.
area.test: In stock PR873 the selected hostile and exact 5.00 m edge alone get the timed record and all eleven ticks. The 5.01 m hostile and allied helper receive nothing. DespoilerFieldsLandOnTheSelectedEnemyAndExactRadiusEdge verifies the same boundary with a live timed effect. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/873#issuecomment-7088259016

targeting.source: GOB 353 requires a selected hostile, has a stored selection range and carries the per-recipient viral test.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler rejects invalid selections before costs, fences the original view and spawn through completion, and applies the shared hostile and sight filters before the viral contest.
targeting.test: Stock PR873 exercises empty and friendly refusals with no cost or timer, then accepts the selected hostile. The updated AbilityRefusalFeedbackTests cover missing, out-of-range and substituted selection cases. The ordinary primary and splash contest path is covered by FreeCastViralLandingTests. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/873#issuecomment-7088259016

behavior-tests.source: GOB 353 specifies a selected hostile viral contest, 5 m radius, 15 IS, two-second cast, 12 s reuse and a fixed 94 ViralDOT pool for 30 s, with updates every 2.5 s.
behavior-tests.runtime: Normal cast admission snapshots the selected entity. AbilityTargets and FreeCastViralContest apply the test separately per eligible recipient and TimedEffects sends the sourced rounded viral ticks through current TypedAbilityResistance.
behavior-tests.test: DespoilerFieldsLandOnTheSelectedEnemyAndExactRadiusEdge proves hostile and sight scope, exact edge, 30 s expiry, temporary edge resistance and no twelfth tick. PR873 covers empty and allied refusal. PR905 verifies the updated 15 IS, cast and reuse, +114 record and eleven 10-point ticks in stock. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/905#issuecomment-7090233496

area.source: GOB 402 stores a selected direct object and a six-metre radius.
area.runtime: AbilityTargets anchors the hostile recipient checks to the selected object's current position on landing.
area.test: PR873 applies all four records only to the primary and the hostile at exactly 6.00 m. The 6.01 m hostile and allied helper are excluded. DespoilerFieldsLandOnTheSelectedEnemyAndExactRadiusEdge covers the same branch. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/873#issuecomment-7088259016

targeting.source: GOB 402 specifies a selected hostile outside combat and a viral test.
targeting.runtime: The strict selection path validates hostile identity, range and sight before costs. The shared area landing path applies the per-recipient viral contest.
targeting.test: PR873 observes normal empty/friendly refusals and the accepted selected cast. AbilityRefusalFeedbackTests add invalid range, blocked sight, combat and stale selection controls. FreeCastViralLandingTests cover admitted area recipients and the viral contest. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/873#issuecomment-7088259016

stats.source: GOB 402 supplies Movement, Sneak Movement and Invisibility Movement at -125, with Force Combat -25, all for 18 seconds.
stats.runtime: AbilityBuffs projects the appropriate movement channel to owner and observers; the signed scale has a lower bound of -1. CombatInsightEngagement reads the Force Combat record during the Evade Combat entry contest.
stats.test: PR873 observes eight adds/removals with -1 observer scale on both admitted views and zero on expiry. BottleneckDebuffStopsBaseMovementWithoutDiscardingASeparateSpeedBuff and BottleneckFieldReducesTheLiveForceScoreUntilExpiry cover the movement channel and actual interlock inputs. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/873#issuecomment-7088259016

behavior-tests.source: GOB 402 defines a selected-area non-damaging cast for 23 IS, two-second cast, 30-second reuse and four 18-second modifiers.
behavior-tests.runtime: Ordinary cast admission, FreeCastViralContest, TimedEffects and the separate movement and force consumers share the actual cast and remover paths.
behavior-tests.test: Stock PR873 measures the cast, cost, reuse, four records per admitted player, no HP or root, and eight removals. AbilityRefusalFeedbackTests, FreeCastViralLandingTests, DesperateSpeedTests and CombatInsightEngagementTests cover pre-cost refusals, radius, coexistence with a positive speed buff and timed force consumption. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/873#issuecomment-7088259016
